*F-NCE* (Non-committing encryption) is part of *Layer 3: Public-Key Primitives, Key Exchange, Messaging* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

*References:*

- Canetti et al. [*Adaptively secure multi-party computation*](https://www.wisdom.weizmann.ac.il/~oded/PSX/dynamic.pdf). In 28th ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing (STOC), 1996.
- Beaver. [*Plug and play encryption*](https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1TncG-y279wPJuWpJsDRmKrcjkiy-JtBY). In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 1997, 1997.
- Nielsen. [*Separating random oracle proofs from complexity theoretic proofs: The non-committing encryption case*](https://iacr.org/archive/crypto2002/24420111/24420111.pdf). In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 2002, pages 111–126, 2002.
